name: Saffron at Hotel Nachana Haveli
why_it_matters: Rooftop restaurant atop the Nachana Haveli heritage hotel, with a head-on view of Jaisalmer Fort lit gold at night. Live Rajasthani folk most evenings. One of the few rooftops outside the fort walls — a useful contrast to the in-fort options.
insider_tip: Book a fort-side table for sunset; the lighting on the fort kicks in around 7 pm and that is the photograph Saffron is known for.
signature_address: Hotel Nachana Haveli, Gandhi Chowk, Sadar Bazar, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan 345001

name: Free Tibet
why_it_matters: Long-running rooftop Tibetan kitchen in the Amar Sagar Pol lane — momos and thukpa are the actual draw, even if the menu has crept into multi-cuisine territory. TripAdvisor 4.5, ranked #22 of 289.
insider_tip: Don't confuse with 'Little Tibet' nearby — different kitchen, similar name. Free Tibet is the one with the Khejer Para entrance.
signature_address: Fort Road, Khejer Para, Manak Chowk, Amar Sagar Pol, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan 345001

name: 8 July Restaurant
why_it_matters: Quiet cafe inside the living fort itself, with palace-side window seats. Apple pie and espresso are the kitchen's reputation; the rest of the menu is competent traveller fare.
insider_tip: It's a fort-only address — vehicles can't reach it. Walk up via the First Fort Gate; the cafe is signed off Kund Para.

name: The Trio
why_it_matters: Operating since 1984 from the gate of Mandir Palace Hotel near Gandhi Chowk — the city's longest-running tourist-circuit rooftop. Live folk musicians most evenings; the tandoori thali is the order locals point to.
insider_tip: The kitchen does Italian on the menu but stick to the tandoor and dal-baati side — that is what the cooks have done for 40 years.
signature_address: Mandir Palace Gate, Gandhi Chowk Road, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan 345001

name: The Legend of Marwad at Suryagarh
why_it_matters: Suryagarh's dinner-only fine-dining restaurant — built around a seven-course tasting menu drawn from old Marwar royal-kitchen and Silk Route recipes, plated with the source story for each dish. Set 12 km from Jaisalmer fort; technically Kahala village but billed as Jaisalmer dining.
insider_tip: Reserve at least 24 hours ahead — they only run one dinner sitting and the seven-course menu cannot be taken a la carte. Pair with the Sham-e-Sarhad sundowner if you arrive earlier.
signature_address: Suryagarh, Kahala Phata, Sam Road, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan 345001

name: Nosh at Suryagarh
why_it_matters: Suryagarh's 24-hour all-day dining room — white walls, rustic stone, and the only proper continental breakfast in Jaisalmer's hotel circuit. Quieter and less ceremonial than the dinner-only Legend of Marwad next door.
insider_tip: Non-residents are welcome but Suryagarh is 12 km out of town — combine the visit with the property's Sham-e-Sarhad ritual at sunset rather than a one-meal drive.
signature_address: Suryagarh, Kahala Phata, Sam Road, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan 345001
